bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123"
sha="98d01c50774545f59f27227755ee910d299c3d48"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch" >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 41
wt="$PWD/.worktrees/video-two-topic-entry-20261123"
git -C "$wt" checkout --detach "$sha" >/dev/null
stage="$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123"
docker build --network host --target build -f "$wt/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-video-entry-builder:20261123 "$wt" > "$stage/build-v2.log" 2>&1 || exit 42
cid="$(docker create gace-video-entry-builder:20261123)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker cp "$cid:/src/artifacts/bot/dist/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs" || exit 43
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs" || exit 44
set +e
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs" > "$stage/dry-v2.log" 2>&1
code=$?
set -e
exit "$code"
